newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's telecoms initiated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil's telecoms initiated.

text.p: -- ING Barings said it has initiated coverage of Brazilian telecommunications firms Telemig and Telepar with a buy rating.
-- It also said it has started coverage of Brazilian telecoms Telerj with a hold recommendation.

-- ING Barings said in a report Telemig, a unit of federal Telebras' system serving Minas Gerais state, reports the highest operating results and offers the best quality in services of any company in the Telebras system.
-- Telemig is expected to earn an estimated $17.87 per ADR in 1997 and $19.21 per ADR in 1998, against estimates of $10.01 per ADR this year, it added.

-- Telepar, Telebras' unit serving Parana state, is ING Barings' top pick among Brazilian telecoms, the report said. "Currently priced at $457 per 1,000 shares, this stock has a target price of $850 per 1,000 shares, showing an upside potential of 86 percent," it said.

-- Regarding Telerj, Telebras' unit serving Rio de Janeiro state, ING Barings said "the company needs the most investment among local companies to support its planned network expansion over the next two years, which includes the addition of approximately 440,000 new wirelines and 325,000 new cellular."
